# Belamba Freelance Quantity Survey Service

> Belamba is a freelance quantity surveyor based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, serving architects, contractors, developers and homeowners worldwide. Services are delivered remotely: quantity takeoffs from architectural and structural drawings, Bills of Quantities (BOQ), rebar bar bending schedules (BBS) and 5D BIM quantity outputs.

Prices are shown on the Pricing page in USD and depend on building size (number of floors) and the scope of work. To request a quote, send your drawings through the contact form or by email.

## Services

- [2D PDF Material Takeoffs](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#services): Quantities taken from PDF architectural and structural drawings.
- [Bill of Quantities (BOQ) Setup](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#services): Priced-ready BOQs in several standards (CSI MasterFormat, RICS NRM 2, DIN 276, ICMS, CSC/CIQS, Metric and Imperial).
- [Rebar & Bar Bending Schedules (BBS)](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#services): Reinforcement schedules from structural drawings.
- [5D BIM Quantity Takeoffs](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#bim-results): Model-based quantity outputs and PlanSwift workflows.
- [Subcontractor Trade Takeoffs](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#services): Trade-specific quantities for subcontractors.
- [Insurance Repair BOQs](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#services): BOQs for repair and restoration claims.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#home): Overview of the remote estimating service.
- [Pricing](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#pricing): Price ranges in USD by building category and scope, plus how the process works.
- [Takeoff Samples](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#samples): Sample BOQ and takeoff layouts in different standards.
- [5D BIM & PlanSwift Results](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#bim-results): Gallery of takeoff layouts and bar bending schedule outputs.
- [Submit Drawings & Contact](https://belamba--global-client-service.pages.dev/#contact): Contact form for project quotes.
